svg.title: Outer country: three regions of eighteen Support
svg.desc: Outlying districts wrap around the northern, western, and southern edges. Compact cities sit inland; Bellweather Centre borders only the urban and mixed regions. Shared border segments define adjacency; corners do not. Bellweather Centre borders only the urban and mixed regions.
svg.text: Urban: 18 / 9 votes Mixed: 18 / 9 votes Outlying: 18 / 9 votes Centre: 3 separate Support
Circles = Support spaces. Heavy lines = region borders. Thin lines = district borders.
Dashed edge / arrows: countryside continues beyond the frame; no extra playable spaces.
